more_info.overview: Silver is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA could not assess food-use safety in 2016 because the tested materials and food additive were insufficiently characterised.
Silver-ion release and particle size were unresolved issues; this does not establish harm at a particular food dose.
